Each verified:true entry was confirmed by an exact match (same count, same titles) between a code's references[] targets and one UI heading, on at least one sample document. group: 'genealogy' = Stage 2 BFS expands through it (finite amendment lineage); 'open_citation' = recorded as an edge but never expanded through (unbounded citation graph). Full corpus scan (7116 docs, 2026-08-24) found exactly these 13 codes; no others exist in the sample.

2.verification_method: elimination, not direct visual match — see docs/crawling-plan.md §3b. This is the one remaining unmatched code among the 13 codes found in the full corpus scan, and 'Văn bản được công bố' is the one remaining unmatched heading on the Lược đồ tab (the other 12 codes/headings all matched directly). Direct visual confirmation was attempted on >2500 sample documents; every occurrence of code 2 had a targetDocument title colliding with another code's target in the same document, and the UI appears to dedupe/hide a heading whose only entries collide with an already-shown heading — so no document was found where code 2 rendered as its own visible section. User (thesis author) reviewed this reasoning and accepted it as verified on 2026-08-24.
